During the [[Second Charge Matrica|Second ''Charge Matrica'']], the [[Death Spiral]] belonging to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] carried several '''three-legged transports''' in its base. These heavily armored [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] fought against the forces of [[Daiman]] during the [[Battle of Gazzari|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gazzari]].
